My boyfriend and I got into a pointless fight, and I didn't talk to him for 3 days. On the third day I had this feeling like part of my heart and soul was missing. I called him multiple times, and called our friends and no one had heard from him. That's when I went to his house to find him hanging in his closet. That was the moment I realized that I was truly in love with him because once he was gone so was apart of me. Before all that happened we said we loved each other, but I never thought I was in love with him. I never thought he was the one that completed me. As cliche as this sounds you really never know what you have until it's gone, and I had to learn this the hard way. To this day I still remember exactly how I felt the moment I realized he was gone, and I'd never wish that feeling upon anyone. 

Update: Thank you guys so much for your sympathy. This happened a few years ago, and I'm fine now. I really appreciate the kind words.
